verified_claims.claim: E. coli 中 Ajikumar 等通过多变量模块化代谢工程将 taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene 提升至 1 g/L、T5α-ol 提升至 58 ± 3 mg/L
verified_claims.evidence: achieving an approximately 15,000-fold increase in taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene production, reaching 1 g/L…taxa-4(5),11(12)-dien-5α-ol (T5α-ol) production increased 2400-fold, reaching 58 ± 3 mg/L

verified_claims.claim: Bacillus subtilis 168 中通过过表达 MEP 途径、IspA 与 GGPPS 将 taxadiene 产量提升 83 倍至 17.8 mg/L
verified_claims.evidence: the overexpression of MEP pathway enzymes, IspA and GGPPS resulted in an 83-fold increase in taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene yield. The engineered strain produced a total taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene yield of 17.8 mg/L

verified_claims.claim: S. cerevisiae 中 resting cell 系统将氧化紫杉烷推至 361.4 ± 52.4 mg/L、T5α-ol 至 38.1 ± 8.4 mg/L
verified_claims.evidence: achieving a maximum oxygenated taxane yield of approximately 361.4 ± 52.4 mg/L using 10 mL resting cell cultures, with T5α-ol reaching 38.1 ± 8.4 mg/L

verified_claims.claim: S. cerevisiae 中通过 MBPig3BAPTm 与 CoAL(A312G)/T2'OGD/T3'NBT 整合获得 paclitaxel 0.59 ± 0.03 μg/L
verified_claims.evidence: achieving a final titer of 0.59 ± 0.03 μg/L

verified_claims.claim: N. benthamiana 中通过 18-/19-基因途径 (含 C13α-O-acetylation-deacetylation 模块) 获得 baccatin III 23 µg/g DW
verified_claims.evidence: the engineered 19-gene pathway produced a baccatin III yield of 23 µg/g dry weight (DW)

verified_claims.claim: TS 在发酵条件下将 93.2% GGPP 转化为 taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene、4.7% 为 taxa-4(20),11(12)-diene，下游 <10% 经 T5αOH 进入目的通路
verified_claims.evidence: TS cyclizes geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate (GGPP) to yield 93.2% taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene, with minor byproducts of 4.7% taxa-4(20),11(12)-diene…less than 10% of the taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene precursor ultimately converted to the target T5α-ol

verified_claims.claim: T10βOH 三点突变 I75F/L226K/S345V 使底物转化率提升 2.8 倍、异源表达量提升 9.5 倍
verified_claims.evidence: the triple mutant I75F/L226K/S345V achieved the highest substrate conversion (2.8-fold increase) and exhibited a 9.5-fold elevation

verified_claims.claim: Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803 DIGT-P560 株从 CO₂ 直接产出 17.43 mg/L 氧化紫杉烷与 4.32 mg/L T5α-ol
verified_claims.evidence: DIGT-P560 achieved production titers of up to 17.43 mg/L of oxygenated taxanes and 4.32 mg/L of T5α-ol

verified_claims.claim: 内生真菌通过物理/化学诱变与原生质体融合可获得 468.62 μg/L 紫杉醇
verified_claims.evidence: with subsequent protoplast fusion events further improving the yield to 468.62 μg/L

verified_claims.claim: FoTO1 与 T5αOH 形成多酶复合物将早期途径产量提升 10-17 倍
verified_claims.evidence: FoTO1 (which complexes with TXS and T5αOH to enhance early pathway yield by 10 to 17-fold)
